title: Apr 16, 2026·Global·NexonUnscheduled COT maintenance ships hotfixes for crafting UI, mob stats, and quality-of-lifeNexon shut the servers down on April 17 for two hours (5 AM to 7 AM PDT). They were going to wait until April 21, but pushed the fixes out earlier. The fixes: the crafting menu now opens when you click on crafting tools, monsters in the Kerning City Party Quest and 2nd job quests are easier to hit, you can close Player Shops with the ESC key, Iron Hogs on Pig Beach spawn at a new rate, gem processing at the Arcforge costs different now, your character plays an animation when you use HP or MP potions, and damage numbers show up even when a monster is on top of you.Closed TestPatchMaintenance
